# Linker

This page intentionally carries one dangling Obsidian link to a page that does
not exist anywhere in the wiki: [[Nonexistent Page]]. The lint engine must flag
that target as a broken-link defect while every other link on this page stays
resolvable, so the seeded defect is exactly one broken link.
